entities.name: Josaphata Hordashevska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josaphata was a Ukrainian Greek Catholic religious sister in the Austro-Hungarian Empire. She was the first member and co-founder of the Sisters Servants of Mary Immaculate.
